public_work.name: gStack
public_work.title: Persistence, concurrency and stale frame state.
public_work.description: Contributed three browser-runtime reliability fixes covering console-log persistence, concurrent state-file writes and stale iframe references. Credited in the release changelog.
public_work.note_title: Three fixes at runtime state boundaries.
note: Console flushing referenced a tracker that had never been declared. Initializing the missing cursor restores periodic console-log persistence; a source-level regression guard checks that referenced flush trackers have matching declarations.

State-file updates used atomic rename but shared one temporary filename. Per-process temporary paths with a random suffix prevent writers from colliding on that intermediate file. Final-state replacement retains last-writer-wins behavior.

Detached-iframe recovery cleared the active frame but retained its reference map. Clearing those references at the same boundary aligns recovery with main-frame navigation. Logic tests cover detached, attached and no-frame states, plus navigation symmetry.
public_work.method: Original contribution PRs #1309, #1310 and #1311 were closed after the fixes shipped through release PR #1391. Their descriptions disclose AI-assisted development and contributor-reported reproduction and test runs. Release source and regression tests were inspected, not executed, for this review.
public_work.evidence_basis: Original authored PRs, maintainer shipping confirmations, merged release PR, and inspected release implementation, regression tests and changelog.

public_work.name: OpenClaw cron validation fix
public_work.title: A one-second boundary in cron validation.
public_work.description: Corrected a validation edge case that could rebase a valid future cron slot. The merged patch adds regression coverage for exact-second schedules.
note: OpenClaw's maintenance path checks whether a persisted future timestamp is a valid cron slot before deciding to repair it. The validator asked for the previous scheduled run at candidate + 1 ms.

Croner's second-granular schedules normalize that probe back to the candidate's second, so the lookup could return the preceding slot. A valid exact-second timestamp then appeared invalid. Existing guards protected nearby future runs; timestamps two or more intervals beyond the natural next slot could still be rebased unexpectedly.

The patch moves the probe to candidate + 1,000 ms, past the candidate's second and consistent with cursor steps elsewhere in the service. The added regression exercises maintenance with a daily 09:00 Pacific/Honolulu schedule and asserts that its valid future timestamp remains unchanged.
public_work.method: AI-assisted drafting with Claude is disclosed in the pull request. Local reproduction and red-to-green testing are contributor-reported; the linked code and regression were inspected, rather than rerun, for this portfolio review.
public_work.evidence_basis: Merged public pull request and inspected implementation and regression.

public_work.name: Accord
public_work.title: Durable work, bounded authority.
public_work.description: An independent TypeScript agent workspace exploring durable task history, versioned updates, reviewed context and scoped permissions.
public_work.note_title: State that outlives a single conversation.
note: Accord records progress as append-only task history and checks the expected version before accepting new reports. Request receipts recover uncertain saves without turning an old receipt into new authority.
The public tests cover competing updates, changed retries, permission revocation and rollback. These make the authority and consistency boundaries inspectable alongside the implementation.
public_work.method: Experimental implementation with a private deployment. Authentication belongs to a person's account; agent profiles are not independent security principals. The service does not wake or run external assistants. Source and tests were inspected, not executed, for this review.
public_work.evidence_basis: Inspected public source, tests and project documentation.
